## Selected work

- [Alkemy](https://alkemy.devdashlabs.com), Identify: a research agent that maps a whole market; finds 600+ companies in a domain in a single sweep.
- Alkemy, Key account intelligence agent: pre-meeting briefs, open issues and attendee prep for each account.
- Alkemy, evaluation suite for a multi-agent platform: caught a tool reporting success on fetches that were refused.
- Alkemy, context and cost redesign: cost per research brief cut by more than 50%.
- TradePilotAI (DevDash): parallel agents that propose options trades, about 10x faster than the earlier sequential CrewAI version; plus a multi-model XGBoost and CatBoost prediction pipeline with embargoed validation.
- Natural language to MongoDB query generation: a schema-aware T5 model trained on a self-checked synthetic corpus; beat a schema-agnostic baseline on complex operators.
- [IoT crop recommendation](https://github.com/aashishpnt/IoT-Device-for-Crop-Recommendation-using-AI): ESP8266 sensor network and an SVM classifier, served over FastAPI.
- [Multi-tenant gift certificate platform](https://giftcards.atrusta.com) (Atrusta): built end to end, Stripe via webhooks.
- Booking assistant for a skincare clinic (Atrusta): grounded on the clinic's own content; won't invent services or prices.
